    Homogeneous rays of a length-graded algebra #

    Proposition 3.8 (projective-rays.tex), for a length-graded representation-finite algebra with idempotents in degree zero and deg 0 corners k e_x (the case of A₀):

    1. "each nonzero ray contains the nonzero vectors of a unique homogeneous line" (exists_hom_mem_ray, mem_span_of_ray_eq);
    2. "For homogeneous f, g of degrees p, q, every element of M(f,g) has homogeneous components only in degrees greater than p+q. Thus fg ∈ M(f,g) exactly when fg = 0" (mul_mem_insertionSpan_iff);
    3. "Associativity of A₀ now gives (3)" (rayProduct_assoc, for arbitrary representatives, through Lemma 3.6).

    Then a homogeneous normed multiplicative basis containing the e_x is, after reindexing, a ray transversal killing zero ray products (hasRayBasis_of_graded): this is the "ray basis" of Corollary 5.5(2).

    def MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.PrimitiveIdempotents.HasRayBasis (k : Type u) [Field k] {B : Type v} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (F : PrimitiveIdempotents B) :
    Prop

    B has a ray basis for F: a normed multiplicative basis indexed by the nonzero rays, a ray transversal, with zero ray products giving zero products (Corollary 5.5(2), Theorem 11.7(2)(3)).
